title: Pokhara vs Chitwan: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Pokhara for spectacular mountain scenery and adventure sports. Chitwan for near-guaranteed rhino sightings and unique jungle immersion. Do both if you have 7+ days — they're only 4 hours apart.

categories.name: Wildlife
categories.summary: Chitwan has 752+ rhinos, 93 tigers, and elephants. Pokhara is not a wildlife destination.

categories.name: Scenery
categories.summary: Phewa Lake + Annapurna views is one of the world's great landscapes. Chitwan is jungle flatlands with no mountain views.

categories.name: Adventure Sports
categories.summary: Pokhara has world-class paragliding, rafting, zip-lining. Chitwan has jungle walks and canoe safaris.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Roughly comparable. Chitwan's all-inclusive packages are better value for wildlife access.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Pokhara has a real lakeside bar and cafe scene. Chitwan is quiet evenings and early starts.

categories.name: Culture
categories.summary: Chitwan's Tharu indigenous culture is unique and underexposed. Pokhara has Gurung and Tibetan culture.

categories.name: Trekking
categories.summary: Pokhara is Nepal's top trekking base (Annapurna Circuit, Poon Hill). Chitwan has no serious trekking.

categories.name: Best Season
categories.summary: October-November is ideal for both destinations simultaneously.

faq.question: Is Pokhara or Chitwan better for a first-time Nepal visitor?
faq.answer: Pokhara is the easier first choice. With 7+ days, do both.
